item.title: Show HN: VeerHost – $1/month web hosting, limited spots
item.summary: Hey HN, We just launched $1/month web hosting for the first year, with only a limited number of spots available. 20GB NVMe, SSL, malware protection, WordPress support, and one website. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49294887 Points: 3 # Comments: 0
